summary: Kootenai NF lookout: camp 1914, cabin and platform 1915, cab 1921, 50-ft pole L-4 tower 1941, destroyed 1975. FFLA index lists it as gone.

facts.design: 50-ft pole L-4 tower from 1941, after a 50-ft three-tree platform with a cab (1915-1941)
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1975; FFLA index lists Tower Gone

events.note: Log cabin and 50-ft three-tree platform built the year after the camp was established
50-ft pole L-4 tower replaced the platform
Tower destroyed; the page gives no cause

evidence.supports: Camp established in 1914; cabin and platform the following year
evidence.quote: Established as a camp in 1914, a log cabin and a 50' 3-tree platform were built the following year.

evidence.supports: Cab added atop the platform in 1921
evidence.quote: A cab was added atop the platform in 1921

evidence.supports: 50-ft pole L-4 tower replaced the platform in 1941
evidence.quote: replaced by a 50' pole L-4 tower in 1941

evidence.supports: Dates 1915-1941 and 1941-1975 for the two structures
Agency is the Kootenai National Forest
FFLA index lists the site as Tower Gone

notes_for_editor: Only firelookout.com gives the history (camp 1914, cabin and platform 1915, cab 1921, pole L-4 tower 1941, destroyed 1975). The Montana Lookouts entry gives only the agency and a township-range; the FFLA index says Tower Gone. Height 15.2 m is converted from the 50-ft pole tower of 1941; no height is given for the 1915 platform. No cause for the 1975 loss appears in any page I read. No photos added. Story is about 130 words.
